dct_description_sm: Underwater glider data, organized by deployment. Glider data typically include ocean temperature, salinity, density, oxygen concentration, and optical properties, collected in a zig-zag vertical/horizontal profile along preplanned lines. Structure is typically `glider-name/glider-name-yyyymmdd`, where the date is the date of the deployment. Data is in usually either "timeseries" data or "trajectoryProfile" data, usually with a suffix "_grid.nc" appended to the file name. Geographic location is specified as a tag, eg "Calvert Line", "Southern Line", "Line P". See https://cproof.uvic.ca for more details.
